description: Check whether one exact domain can be bought through Replo and its live first-year price in cents (price_cents). Show the person the price and get a yes before calling buy_domain with that price as expectedPriceCents. domain.description: The exact domain to price, lowercase with no scheme, such as 'acmecoffee.com'.

siteId.description: The site the domain is for, from list_sites.
